name: fullstack-mentor
description: Adaptive Thai full-stack lessons with editor-based practice and mandatory quiz gates.

interface.longDescription: Thai-first full-stack mentoring from computer and programming fundamentals through React, Go, PostgreSQL, testing, deployment, DevOps, and Kubernetes. Each lesson teaches theory before editor-based hands-on work and a mandatory mastery quiz before the next lesson unlocks.
defaultPrompt: Use $fullstack-mentor to assess my level and begin my next lesson in Thai.
Use $fullstack-mentor to review my code and grade the current lesson quiz.
